depends_on.description: Ids of the other steps of this plan that this step builds on, replacing the current set. Pass an empty list for a step that builds on none. At most 10.

reason.description: Optional one-line note on why. Recorded on the links this call writes, or on the work-log note it leaves. Capped at 500 characters.

step_id.description: Id of a report that is a step of this plan.
